rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Comprehensive Discord server administration tool providing 33 tools covering channel management, role management, member moderation, and server configuration. Built with TypeScript and Bun using direct Discord REST API v10 calls, featuring per-route bucket rate limiting, automatic retry logic, and audit log reasons for all write operations. Includes composite tools for common multi-step workflows like category setup, channel lockdown, and bulk role assignment.
